entities.summary: Jannicke Jane Mikkelsen is a Norwegian commercial astronaut, cinematographer, film director who has worked in the field of virtual reality (VR) cinematography, 3D animation and augmented reality technology, focusing on fringe technology and combining traditional film production with new technologies for films shot in remote areas.
